assertion: The average duration of unemployment rose to 27.1 weeks in October, the highest outside of the pandemic period in a decade.
warehouse_value: LNS13008275 Oct 2026 = 27.1 (Sep 24.8); last non-pandemic reading at or above 27.1 was Aug 2016 (27.2)
sql: SELECT year, period, value FROM econ.employment_statistics WHERE series='LNS13008275' AND year>=2014 AND value>=26.5 ORDER BY year, period

assertion: About 2 million people had been unemployed for at least 27 weeks, accounting for 27.6% of all unemployed workers.
sql: SELECT series, year, period, value FROM econ.employment_statistics WHERE series IN ('LNS13008636','LNS13025703') AND year=2026 AND period='M10'

warehouse_value: Share: Dec 2021 31.2, Jan 2022 25.2, Feb 2022 26.9; no month 2022-Sep 2026 at or above 27.6
sql: SELECT year, period, value FROM econ.employment_statistics WHERE series='LNS13025703' AND year>=2021 AND value>=25 ORDER BY year, period

assertion: Nonfarm payrolls blew past economists' forecasts for October and added 165,000 jobs. The unemployment rate ticked down to 4.1%.
sql: SELECT series, year, period, value FROM econ.employment_statistics WHERE series IN ('CES0000000001','LNS14000000') AND year=2026 AND period IN ('M09','M10')
independent_value: CNBC jobs report: forecast 59,000, 4.2% unemployment forecast

assertion: 'But if you look over a longer time horizon, there is no mistake in the trend.'
speaker: Cory Stahle, Indeed
warehouse_value: Avg duration 22.0 (Jan 2025) to 24-27 in 2026; share 21.1% to 25-27.6%; month-to-month noisy (Aug 26.3, Sep 24.8, Oct 27.1)
sql: SELECT series, year, period, value FROM econ.employment_statistics WHERE series IN ('LNS13008275','LNS13025703') AND year>=2025 ORDER BY series, year, period

assertion: Workers stop being able to claim most, if not all, government unemployment benefits after 26 weeks in a year.
independent_value: Typical state benefit cap is 26 weeks, per Urban Institute's Congdon quoted in CNBC's June article; some states cap lower

assertion: 'Now, the average unemployed person takes longer to find a job than their benefits would last.'
speaker: Cory Stahle, Indeed
warehouse_value: Mean duration of ongoing spells 27.1 wks in Oct but 24.4-26.3 in prior 2026 months, mostly under 26; and it measures incomplete spells, not time to find a job
reason: Rests on one noisy month; mean ongoing duration is not completed time to find work
sql: SELECT year, period, value FROM econ.employment_statistics WHERE series='LNS13008275' AND year=2026 ORDER BY period
